Gen Z Leads Investment in Traditional Finance Products, Study Finds

A study by Binance Research indicates that Generation Z is leading net accumulation across various traditional finance (TradFi) products. The research highlights a trend of younger investors actively engaging with established financial instruments. Specific details on the TradFi products or the extent of Gen Z's accumulation were not provided in the coverage.
